summary: Lipocine Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 20, 2026, disclosing that it has updated the corporate presentation used in investor and analyst meetings, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, with the cover page and signature by CEO Mahesh V. Patel also included. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural or regulatory terms are stated; the event is an ordinary investor-communications update. What to watch: nothing deal-related — monitor future clinical or regulatory disclosures rather than any special-situation catalyst.
